title: pvCountCellFaces
body:
## pvCountCellFaces

Adds a cell array (default name "Face Count") with the number of faces of each cell, as reported by VTK: 6 for a hexahedron, 4 for a tetrahedron, the face count of a polyhedron, and 0 for 2-D and lower cells, whose edges are not faces. Use it to inspect polyhedral meshes, e.g. from snappyHexMesh, or to threshold cells by face count.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Surface meshes give 0 everywhere; use pvCountCellVertices for polygons.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CountCellFaces`. Identity: `filters/CountCellFaces`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
